$comment: Reader support. The /support page, the home-page supporters band and the footer link stay off until a checkout link is set. Checkout links are Stripe Payment Links at the matching price, each collecting: name to show, website (optional), and given by (optional). List supporters only with their consent, after review, exactly as they asked: {"name", "kind": "person" | "institution", "tier": "founder" | "year" | "in-kind", "since": "YYYY-MM-DD", "url"?, "givenBy"?}. A "year" listing ends twelve months after "since".
